headline: Unbalanced optimal transport and bridge models recover continuous dynamics from snapshot omics
label: Constrained Dynamics From Snapshots
summary: New preprints add lineage barcodes, chromatin coupling, spatial context and interpretable states to trajectory inference from static single-cell and spatial snapshots.
synthesis: The dominant thread is reconstructing continuous cell dynamics from discrete snapshots using unbalanced transport formulations. COATI uses synchronized optimal transport to couple scRNA and scATAC trajectories across held-out stages. LOTUS adds lineage barcodes to unbalanced optimal transport for clonal fate dynamics. CytoBridge applies an unbalanced mean-field Schrodinger bridge to spatial transcriptomics snapshots. A Latent Cell-State Model instead treats transitions as a Markov chain with interpretable states. What is new is the extra constraint layered onto trajectory inference: multimodal coupling, clonal lineage, spatial interaction and state interpretability. CloneVI, CRISP, OncoSpot and scDisentangle address related single-cell and spatial problems (mitochondrial clones, cross-signal interactions, simulation benchmarking, perturbation prediction) but do not share the dynamics framing.
